claims.proof-base-drift: Fixed. Proof fingerprints and review bindings now include the tested pull-request base SHA; publication, review, and merge read back both head and base, while base drift requires a fresh try, affected checks and proof, and a new review visit. [candidate-design]
claims.incomplete-lifecycle-graph: Fixed. The frozen graph now defines capability and reconciliation waits, typed failure, cancellation, denial, and terminal outcomes, and permits normal Workflow return only after D1 commits succeeded, denied, or canceled. [candidate-design]
claims.human-identity-enrollment: Fixed. Settings now verifies an active Linear user's normalized email against the Access-authenticated Gmail address, persists a revisioned project binding, revalidates it at allocation, freezes it into the run, and fails closed when unavailable or stale. [candidate-design]
claims.clarification-comment-readback: Fixed. Every candidate clarification reply is read back by comment ID immediately before assessment and checked for issue, actor, order, current body, edits, and deletion; an accepted body is stored as an immutable R2 snapshot with a D1 digest and receipt. [candidate-design]
claims.capability-policy-timing: Fixed. A reviewed maximum policy is frozen at allocation, the provider-free task job returns requested operation IDs, and trusted validation derives and freezes a narrower design-and-task-bound policy before the first implementation try. [candidate-design]
claims.test-resource-reconciliation: Fixed. Every provider test-resource lifecycle verb receives a stable operation key, with lookup or inventory reconciliation, idempotency constraints, revocation and deletion handling, duplicate quarantine, and manual reconciliation for unresolved effects. [candidate-design]
claims.openspec-post-merge-tail: Fixed. code_merged is now a nonterminal milestone followed by a typed mechanical OpenSpec archive and reconciliation PR; success is committed only after validation, checks, merge, and read-back, with semantic changes or conflicts failing closed. [candidate-design]
